summary.headline: Sharda Cropchem FY26 PAT rose 124% to INR 681 crores on record revenue of INR 5,268 crores; FY27 revenue guided at 10-15%.
summary.overview: Q4 FY26 revenue grew 13% YoY to INR 2,065 crores, with EBITDA up 75% to INR 513 crores and PAT up 57% to INR 319 crores. Gross margin expanded 750 bps to 37.3%, aided by a sharp rise in FX contribution (+11.7% in Q4). For FY26, revenue rose 22% to INR 5,268 crores, EBITDA rose 69% to INR 1,040 crores (19.7% margin), and PAT rose 124% to INR 681 crores. The company remains debt-free with INR 702 crores of cash and liquid investments. Management guided FY27 revenue growth of 10-15%, gross margin around 35% plus or minus a few points, and EBITDA margin of 18-20%.

segments.name: Agrochemical
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 1,927 crores (+14% YoY); FY26 revenue INR 4,717 crores (+25% YoY). Q4 volume +5%.

segments.name: Non-agrochemical (conveyor belts)
segments.commentary: Q4 FY26 revenue INR 138 crores (+0.3% YoY); FY26 INR 551 crores (+1%). Q4 volume -2%. Management guides 5-10% growth for FY27; made-to-order model.

segments.name: Europe
segments.commentary: Gross margin 41.5% in Q4 and 42.5% for FY26 (CFO-level figure quoted as ~42% in a later answer); FY26 volume growth about 16%. Management expects similar growth in FY27.

segments.name: NAFTA
segments.commentary: Gross margin 28% in Q4 and 25% for FY26. Analyst noted about 6% revenue decline; management cited no specific cause, possibly weather and US economy.

segments.name: LATAM
segments.commentary: Gross margin 28% in Q4 and 25% for FY26. Volume growth cited as a key contributor alongside Europe.

segments.name: Rest of World
segments.commentary: Gross margin 46% in Q4 and 43% for FY26.

guidance_outlook: FY27 revenue growth guided at 10-15% (management clarified this is revenue, not EBITDA; earlier 15-20% reference was not confirmed).
FY27 gross margin expected around 35%, plus or minus a few points; management said 34-37% range is possible.
FY27 volume growth indicated at around 15% in response to a question, with realisation implied to be lower; management did not confirm.
Effective tax rate for FY27 and FY28 expected at 18-20%.
Non-agrochemical business expected to grow 5-10% in FY27.
capex_capacity: Capex for FY26 stood at INR 505 crores.
Total product registrations at 31 March 2026: 3,011; a further 1,004 registration applications are in the pipeline globally.
Management expects many registrations in FY27 but declined to give timing or count, citing regulatory and field-trial uncertainty.
Working capital days at 98 as on 31 March 2026, improved by 20 days vs March 2025.
demand_pricing: Q4 FY26 revenue bridge: volume +4.3%, FX +11.7%, price and product mix -3.0%, total +2.9% (as read out; reported revenue growth was 13%, so the bridge components do not reconcile to the headline).
FY26 revenue bridge: volume +13.4%, FX +10.3%, price and mix -1.8%, total +21.9%.
Management said procurement prices from China have not risen significantly, with only small increases on some products.
Management said 80-90% of raw material price increases have historically been passed on to customers, citing limited competition in registered agrochemicals.
Revenue from products launched in the last 3-4 years estimated at about 30%. Top 5 products contribute about 22% of revenue.
Company supplies about 70-75 countries; market share is under 5% globally.
Shipments from China are being routed via South Africa rather than Hormuz; delays are present but considered insignificant, with a slight rise in freight cost.

qa_highlights.question: Q4 growth bridge: contribution of FX and realisation?
qa_highlights.answer: Q4 volume +4.3%, FX +11.7%, price/mix -3.0%; FY26 volume +13.4%, FX +10.3%, price/mix -1.8%.

qa_highlights.question: FY27 guidance on revenue, gross margin and EBITDA?
qa_highlights.answer: Revenue +10-15%, gross margin around 35% plus or minus a few points, EBITDA margin 18-20%. Management said the 18-20% range refers to EBITDA, not revenue.

qa_highlights.question: Forex loss of INR 26 crores in Q4 despite a tight USD/EUR range?
qa_highlights.answer: CFO said it was mainly unrealised loss on realignment of foreign currency payables, measured at quarter-end rates; management said it is not an actual loss.

qa_highlights.question: Gross margin excluding forex impact for FY26?
qa_highlights.answer: Management did not provide the figure on the call and offered to follow up through investor relations.

qa_highlights.question: Is the FY27 10-15% growth assumption dependent on new registrations?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said growth is not fully dependent on new registrations; it is driven by market share, customer confidence and underlying agriculture demand.

qa_highlights.question: Has the company benefited from off-patent products?
qa_highlights.answer: Management said going off-patent is a normal market trend and the company selects from innovator-presented products after the 10-year patent period.

risks_watch: FX volatility: Q4 included INR 26 crores of unrealised forex loss, and FX contributed +11.7% to Q4 growth, so the reported margin and growth may not repeat.

Realisation and price-mix were negative (-3.0% in Q4, -1.8% in FY26), and FY27 volume growth of about 15% alongside 10-15% revenue growth implies a possible price decline, which management did not confirm.
Registration pipeline and approval timelines are uncertain; the registration count rose only from about 2,700 in FY22 to 3,011 in FY26.
Geopolitical risk (Middle East war, shipping routes, freight costs) and weather affecting NAFTA demand; NAFTA revenue declined about 6%.
Inventory normalisation in distribution channels; the company has previously had a 2022 inventory write-off.
Management did not give the ex-FX gross margin or region-wise FY27 guidance; sales return data was not disclosed.
summary.management_tone: Confident on FY26 results and the demand outlook, but evasive on details: management declined to give region-wise guidance, ex-FX margin and sales returns, and corrected its own earlier guidance wording (EBITDA vs revenue) during the call. Guidance was framed as an "impression" that "can change".
key_quotes: Despite the global headwinds from tariffs and the recent war, we have delivered our best-ever annual PAT, our highest-ever EBITDA, and our strongest-ever revenue performance.
There is nothing to worry. The prices have been stable and there has been a slight increase in the prices.
We are not dealing with products which are freely tradable and registration process is very expensive and time consuming and not very interesting to most of the investors.
I would say top 5, the contribution is about 22%. But I think it could be more.

growth.why: FY27 revenue guided at 10-15% (midpoint 12.5%, cut from 15-20%), with Europe volume growth expected similar to FY26 (~16%) and non-agro 5-10%, but no specific capacity additions, orders or timelines were given, and the Q4 revenue bridge does not reconcile to headline growth.

rows.label: Margin expansion
rows.why: FY26 gross margin rose 600 bps to 35.9% and FY27 is guided at about 35% plus or minus a few points, so FY27 gross margin is guided down from FY26's 35.9% level and EBITDA margin of 18-20% sits below FY26's 19.7% only at the low end; Europe GM at 42.5% supports mix but ex-FX margin was not disclosed.

rows.label: Volume growth
rows.why: FY27 volume growth indicated at around 15% (not confirmed by management), Europe volume expected similar to FY26's ~16%, and FY26 volume grew 13.4%; Q4 volume was only +4.3%.

rows.label: New capex announcement
rows.why: No utilisation figure or capacity plan was disclosed; FY26 capex of INR 505 crores is reported but no new plant or line was named.

rows.label: Guidance upgrade
rows.why: Management guided FY27 revenue at 10-15% and EBITDA margin at 18-20%, with no sign of running ahead of plan; FX tailwind is not guaranteed to repeat.

rows.label: Guidance downgrade
rows.why: FY27 revenue growth was cut to 10-15% from 15-20%, and Q4 growth of 13% was helped by FX (+11.7%) while price/mix was -3.0%, so the FX tailwind may not repeat.

rows.label: New product launch
rows.why: Management expects many registrations in FY27 but declined to give timing or count; 3,011 registrations held at 31 March 2026 with 1,004 applications in the pipeline.

rows.label: Price/mix negative; raw material pass-through
rows.why: Price and mix was -3.0% in Q4 and -1.8% in FY26; management says 80-90% of raw material increases are historically passed through, and China procurement prices have risen only slightly.

rows.label: NAFTA revenue decline
rows.why: NAFTA revenue fell about 6% with no specific cause given; management cited weather and US economy, and NAFTA gross margin is only 28% in Q4.

rows.label: Working capital days improvement
rows.why: Working capital days at 98 on 31 March 2026, improved by 20 days from March 2025, and the company remains debt-free with INR 702 crores of cash and liquid investments.

tone.note: Management was confident on FY26 results and the demand outlook but evasive on region-wise guidance, ex-FX margin and sales returns, and corrected its own EBITDA-vs-revenue guidance wording; analysts pushed on FX contribution, price/mix, and whether FY27 implies a price decline.
